message.content:
**Paris Get‑away Planner**  
*(Assuming a 7‑day trip, mid‑April 2025 – a lovely time when the weather is mild and the city is just starting to bloom.)*

| Day | Time | Activity | Notes |
|-----|------|----------|-------|
| **Day 1** | 08:00 | Fly from JFK → CDG (direct, 7 h) | Book early‑morning flight; arrive 15:00 local time. |
| | 16:30 | Check‑in at Hôtel Le Meurice (5 ★) | 2‑bedroom suite, central location, free Wi‑Fi. |
| | 18:00 | Dinner at Le Cinq (Michelin 3‑star) | Reserve 2 hrs; dress code: smart casual. |
| | 20:30 | Seine river cruise (Bateaux Mouches) | Sunset view of Eiffel Tower. |
| **Day 2** | 09:00 | Breakfast at Café de Flore | Classic French croissants & café au lait. |
| | 10:00 | Louvre Museum | Pre‑book tickets; 2 hrs. |
| | 13:00 | Lunch at Café Marly (inside Louvre) | Light French cuisine. |
| | 14:30 | Palais Royal & Gardens | Stroll & photo ops. |
| | 16:00 | Shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré | Designer boutiques & concept stores. |
| | 19:00 | Dinner at L’Arpège (Michelin 3‑star) | Vegetarian focus; book 2 hrs. |
| **Day 3** | 08:30 | Breakfast at Hotel | Continental breakfast. |
| | 09:30 | Day trip to Versailles | 30 min RER; tour palace & gardens (3 hrs). |
| | 13:30 | Picnic lunch in Versailles gardens | Bring baguette, cheese, wine. |
| | 17:00 | Return to Paris | Evening stroll along Champs‑Élysées. |
| | 20:00 | Dinner at Le Relais de l’Entrecôte | Famous steak‑frites; no reservations needed. |
| **Day 4** | 09:00 | Breakfast at Hotel | Continental breakfast. |
| | 10:00 | Montmartre & Sacré‑Coeur | Explore artists’ square, climb to basilica. |
| | 12:30 | Lunch at Le Consulat | Traditional French bistro. |
| | 14:00 | Musée d’Orsay | Impressionist masterpieces (2 hrs). |
| | 17:00 | Return to hotel | Relax & freshen up. |
| | 19:30 | Dinner at Septime (Michelin 1‑star) | Modern French tasting menu; book 2 hrs. |
| **Day 5** | 08:00 | Breakfast at Hotel | Continental breakfast. |
| | 09:00 | Day trip to Giverny (Monet’s Garden) | 45 min train; guided tour (3 hrs). |
| | 13:00 | Lunch at La Maison du Jardin | Farm‑to‑table French cuisine. |
| | 16:00 | Return to Paris | Evening free. |
| | 20:00 | Dinner at Le Jules Verne (Eiffel Tower) | 2‑star Michelin; sunset view. |
| **Day 6** | 09:00 | Breakfast at Hotel | Continental breakfast. |
| | 10:00 | Notre‑Dame & Île de la Cité | Historic cathedral & Sainte‑Chapelle (2 hrs). |
| | 13:00 | Lunch at Le Petit Cler | Charming market street café. |
| | 14:30 | Latin Quarter & Sorbonne | Walk through historic streets. |
| | 17:00 | Return to hotel | Relax. |
| | 19:30 | Dinner at L’Ambroisie (Michelin 3‑star) | Classic French haute cuisine; book 2 hrs. |
| **Day 7** | 08:30 | Breakfast at Hotel | Continental breakfast. |
| | 10:00 | Last‑minute shopping at Galeries Lafayette | Iconic department store. |
| | 12:30 | Lunch at Café Marly | Light lunch before departure. |
| | 14:00 | Check‑out & transfer to CDG | 2 hrs travel. |
| | 18:00 | Fly back to JFK | Arrive 21:00 local time. |

---

### Budget Overview (per person)

| Category | Cost (USD) |
|----------|------------|
| Flights (economy round‑trip) | $650 |
| Accommodation (7 nights, 2‑bedroom suite) | $2,400 |
| Dining (incl. 3 Michelin meals) | $1,200 |
| Transport (RER, metro, taxis) | $200 |
| Attractions & tours | $300 |
| Miscellaneous (souvenirs, tips) | $200 |
| **Total** | **$5,850** |

> *Prices are approximate and may vary with season, availability, and currency fluctuations.*

---

### Packing Checklist

| Item | Notes |
|------|-------|
| Light jacket & scarf | April can be breezy. |
| Comfortable walking shoes | City streets are cobblestone. |
| Umbrella | Rain showers possible. |
| Power adapter (Type C/F) | For charging devices. |
| Travel insurance | Coverage for health & cancellations. |
| Passport & visa documents | Ensure validity >6 months. |
| Copies of reservations | Keep digital & paper copies. |

---

### Tips & Hacks

1. **Book museum tickets online** – skip the long queues.  
2. **Use the “Paris Pass”** – includes public transport & free entry to many attractions.  
3. **Reserve Michelin restaurants 2–3 weeks ahead** – especially for dinner at Le Cinq or L’Arpège.  
4. **Take advantage of the “Paris Visite” pass** – unlimited metro, bus, and RER within zones 1‑3.  
5. **Try local markets** – Marché des Enfants Rouges for lunch or a quick snack.  
6. **Stay hydrated** – carry a reusable water bottle; tap water is safe.  

---

### Final Checklist Before Departure

- [ ] Confirm flight times & check‑in online.  
- [ ] Print or download hotel confirmation.  
- [ ] Verify all restaurant reservations.  
- [ ] Pack essential documents (passport, visas, insurance).  
- [ ] Set up international roaming or local SIM.  
- [ ] Arrange airport transfer (Uber, taxi, or hotel shuttle).  

Enjoy your Paris adventure! Bon voyage!
